name: Starlink resumes sign-ups in Nairobi after a 7-month pause
snippet: Jun 23, 2025 — After more than seven months of blocking new users, Starlink is taking fresh sign-ups in Nairobi and other parts of Kenya .

name: Starlink halts new sign-ups in seven counties as capacity
snippet: Jul 7, 2026 — Starlink has suspended new customer sign-ups in seven counties including Nairobi, Kiambu, Mombasa, and Machakos after surging demand exhausted ...

name: Starlink suspends new signups across seven Kenyan
snippet: Jul 8, 2026 — The seven counties affected by the suspension are Nairobi, Kiambu, Machakos, Kajiado, Murang'a, Nakuru and Uasin Gishu. Read more
